title: 网站编辑
Website editor
intro: 选择页面，修改文字或图片。先预览，发布后客人才会看到。
Choose a page, edit its text or images, then preview. Visitors see changes only after you publish.
imageHelp: 上传 JPG、PNG、WebP、AVIF 或 BMP，最大 12 MB；按原比例显示。HEIC 请先导出为 JPG。
Upload JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or BMP up to 12 MB. Images keep their proportions. Export HEIC as JPG first.
previewHelp: 预览中的链接和表单不执行操作。
Links and forms are inactive in this preview.
restoreHelp: 载入后可继续编辑，保存并发布才会更新网站。
Keep editing after loading. Save and publish to update the website.
conflict: 内容已在另一个窗口更新。你的修改仍在，请先保存副本，再重新读取服务器版本。
Another window updated this content. Your edits are still here. Copy them before reloading the server version.
placeholders: 请保留文字中的 {v0} 等动态占位符。
Keep dynamic placeholders such as {v0} in the text.
school_two_four_hours: 开学优惠 · 双人四小时（CAD）
School offer · two people, four hours (CAD)
searchAllHelp: 输入页面上看到的文字，定位到对应模块
Enter text from a page to find its module
uploaded: 图片已加入当前草稿，发布后网站才会更新。
Image added to this draft. Publish to update the website.
originalImageHelp: 上传 JPG、PNG 或 WebP，最大 12 MB，保留原图。
Upload JPG, PNG or WebP up to 12 MB. Original images are preserved.
diagnosticsHelp: 保留最近 2000 条写入或失败请求，不记录图片、文案、联系人和登录凭据。
The latest 2,000 write or failed requests are retained. Images, copy, contacts and sign-in credentials are excluded.
healthy: 服务连接与数据库正常
Service connection and database are healthy
uploadTimeout: 上传超时，草稿仍在。请检查网络后重新选择图片。
The upload timed out. Your draft is safe. Check your connection and choose the image again.
